job.question: What was the proposal deadline in the Hawaii ERS RFP for private equity consulting services published in 2022?
job.acceptance: Accept date/time/Hawaii Standard Time equivalents. Issue date, RFP number and later best-and-final deadline are optional context.

reviews.reason: This is an Oklahoma OPERS RFP for general investment consulting services, not the Hawaii ERS RFP for private equity consulting services. Its proposal deadline therefore does not support the requested deadline.
quotes: THE OKLAHOMA PUBLIC EMPLOYEES RETIREMENT SYSTEM REQUEST FOR PROPOSAL #515-22-200 INVESTMENT CONSULTING SERVICES
OPERS is seeking the services of a general investment consultant
The deadline for receipt of proposals is 4:30 p.m. Central Time, on March 25, 2022.
